Name: Glyph
Description: A card used to shape Developments or cast Invocations.

Name: World Shard
Description: A broken fragment of the Old World, floating in the Cloud Sea, now ready to be restored into a new home for Settlers.

Name: Yield
Description: The results of your Developments, such as Food or Knowledge, which can be gathered over the course of the Expedition, spent at Landmarks, and used during Events.

Name: Essence Slot
Description: A requirement within a Development or Task that must be filled with a matching Essence.

Name: Essence
Description: The elemental force used to create Developments in Sites, usually provided by Slotting glyphs.

Name: Hand
Description: The current set of Glyphs available to play in a Stage.

Name: Expedition
Description: A full journey to restore a World Shard, made up of multiple Phases.

Name: Companion
Description: Animal spirits which can join you during your expeditions and provide unique abilities.

Name: Phase
Description: One part of an Expedition, where you establish several Settlements then connect them to the Shard Capital.

Name: Slot
Description: Using a glyph for its Essence to fill an Essence Slot.

Name: Settler Quest
Description: A task offered by a settler that lasts a single expedition and adds a difficulty modifier.

Name: Relic
Description: A symbolic item that grants a special effect during an Expedition, usually acquired from Events or at the end of a Phase.

Name: Play
Description: Using a glyph either to slot into an Essence Slot or to cast its Invocations.

Name: Inspiration
Description: Your guiding resolve. If it runs out, the Expedition ends prematurely and you forfeit bonus Insights.

Name: Haven
Description: Your resting place between Expeditions, where you prepare, reflect, and grow.

Name: Explorer Trip
Description: A trip which the Explorer takes to a previously settled shard. Such trips take one phase and may reveal new skills or relics.

Name: Glyph Deck
Description: The collection of Glyphs you bring into an Expedition and draw from during Stages.

Name: Change
Description:
One of the three Basic Essences.

[i]“The force of motion, heat, and transition. It drives the wind, stirs the fire, and turns the seasons.”[/i]

Name: Connection
Description:
One of the four Advanced Essences. Used during Convergence to connect settlements to the Shard Capital.

[i]“The bonds that link people, places, and purpose. It bridges distances and lingers in a shared glance.”[/i]

Name: Craft
Description:
One of the four Advanced Essences.

[i]“The touch of human effort, shaping, and refining. It carves, builds, and brings purpose to raw form.”[/i]

Name: Radiance
Description:
One of the four Advanced Essences.

[i]“The glow of light and the spark of knowledge. It reveals paths and turns darkness into discovery.”[/i]

Name: Life
Description:
One of the three Basic Essences.

[i]“The breath of vitality, water, and growth. It fills rivers, nourishes roots, and renews the land.”[/i]

Name: Stability
Description:
One of the three Basic Essences.

[i]“The foundation of stone, structure, and stillness. It endures, unshaken by time or chaos.”[/i]

Name: Spirit
Description:
One of the four Advanced Essences.

[i]“The trace of something greater. It fuels wonder and flickers at the edge of knowing.”[/i]

Name: Food
Description:
Food production.

Can be invested at a Stone of Remembrance to host feasts that commemorate glyphs to make them Innate.

“Feeds the hungry, strengthens bodies, and supports growing communities.”

Name: Beauty
Description:
Beauty in nature and human endeavors.

Can be spent at a Verse Arena to restore Inspiration.

“Lifts the spirit, awakens wonder, and turns the ordinary into something unforgettable.”

Name: Harmony
Description:
Human and environmental harmony.

Can be invested at Post Road to connect Settlements, making the next Convergence easier.

“Reduces conflict, fosters cooperation, and strengthens communities.”

Name: Knowledge
Description:
Learning and enlightenment.

Can be invested at a Woodblock Print Studio to recall inscribed glyphs and add them to your Glyph Deck.

“Educates people, advances technology, and deepens understanding.”

Name: Adventure
Description:
Thrilling opportunities. 

Can be spent at Mirage Gates to acquire rare and powerful glyphs to add to your Glyph Deck.

“Provides excitement, challenges the bold, and opens paths to new discoveries.”

Name: Productivity
Description:
Dedicated human craftsmanship.

Can be invested at Communal Baths to purify your Glyph Deck by removing glyphs.

“Supplies materials, enables craftsmanship, and drives economic growth.”

Name: Safety
Description:
Protection from the elements and human follies.

Can be invested at Endless Ruins to excavate Relics.

“Protects people from danger, secures shelter, and ensures stability.”

Name: Turn
Description: The period during which you play a single hand of glyphs before redrawing or finishing a stage. By default, each stage consists of two turns.

Name: Discard
Description: Moving a glyph to the Discards for any reason. Not limited to the Discard invocation.

Name: Invocation
Description: A spell-like ability cast from a Glyph instead of slotting it into an Essence Slot. Glyphs with multiple Invocations cast them all in order.

Name: Inscribe
Description: Creating new Glyphs to use as Signature Glyphs at the start of an Expedition, by combining Strokes in the Haven.

Name: Innate
Description: Glyphs that are guaranteed to be drawn first at the beginning of a Stage.

Name: Keep
Description: Marking a Glyph as Kept at the end of an Expedition, which will add it to your starting Glyph Deck on your next Expedition.

Name: Challenge
Description: Extra challenges during stages, attributed to hauntings in ages past. Challenges can affect a specific site or the whole settlement. They can be countered by filling their associated essence slots.

Name: Convergence Task
Description: A task during Convergence that requires Essence to accomplish, such as connecting Settlements or fulfilling Shortages.

Name: Convergence
Description: A key moment at the end of each Phase where you make up for your Settlements' Shortages.

Name: Discards
Description: Glyphs that have already been discarded, but will be reshuffled into the draw stack when it is exhausted. They can be retrieved to your hand using Recycle.

Name: Hand Size
Description: The number of glyphs drawn into your Hand at the beginning of a Stage, and on each Redraw.

Name: Draw
Description: Moving a glyph from the Draw Stack to your Hand.

Name: Draw Stack
Description: The stack of glyphs waiting to be drawn during a Stage.

Name: Encounter
Description: A dilemma encountered during Surveys resolved using glyphs.

Name: Foray
Description: A focused effort to establish a new Settlement, where you play glyphs to develop Sites.

Name: Fill
Description: Filling an Essence Slot with Essence, in order to activate Developments or Tasks.

Name: Event
Description: An interactive vignette that can lead to a variety of outcomes.

Name: Survey
Description: A brief exploration of a map region, where a survey team scouts the wilderness in preparation for future forays. Consists of several Encounters resolved using glyphs.

Name: Stroke
Description: Pieces of a glyph that can be used to inscribe new glyphs in the Haven, to use as Signature Glyphs at the start of an expedition. Strokes are acquired when you salvage glyphs at the end of a completed phase.

Name: Specialization
Description: A type of Yield that a Settlement can provide. Connect this Settlement to the Shard Capital to share the yield with settlements that have a shortage of this yield.

Name: Foray Goal
Description: A type of Yield required to complete a Foray without losing Inspiration.

Name: Stage
Description: A Foray, Convergence, or Survey.

Name: Development
Description: A specific transformation of a Site, shaped by Essences and providing various Yields. You can only choose one Development per tier. Higher-tier upgrades for that path stay open.

Name: Site
Description: A small feature within a Foray, like a forest or a ruin, which serves as a base for Developments that produce Yields.

Name: Task
Description: A task that requires essences to accomplish, encountered during surveys and convergences.

Name: Skill
Description: An ability permanently unlocked in the Haven by spending Insights.

Name: Simple
Description: Glyphs with one Essence and no Invocations.

Name: Signature Glyph
Description: A Glyph which you choose to add to your Glyph Deck at the beginning of an Expedition. You can only choose Glyphs which you have previously Inscribed.

Name: Landmark
Description: A permanent unique development in a settlement where you can invest Yields to gain powerful benefits or upgrades.

Name: Shard Culture
Description: The type of society a given World Shard can develop. Shards with notable cultures are revealed at the end of an Expedition, based on the yields, narrative choices, or other decisions made by its settlers.

Name: Settlement
Description: A Location that has been settled after a Foray and now contributes to the World Shard.

Name: Fulfill
Description: Fulfilling a Settlement's Shortage by completing a Convergence Task during Convergence.

Name: Salvage
Description: Choosing a Glyph from your Glyph Deck at the end of a completed Expedition to convert into Strokes which can be used to Inscribe new Glyphs in the Haven.

Name: Reserve
Description: Marking a Glyph reward option as reserved. This will guarantee that the same Glyph will appear the next time you are offered a Glyph to choose.

Name: Reroll
Description: Getting new random choices when offered to choose a Glyph or Relic. Rerolls can be gained by unlocking Skills, but can only be used a limited number of times per Expedition.

Name: Remove
Description: Removing a Glyph from your Glyph Deck for the rest of an Expedition. By default, the minimum size of your Glyph Deck is 10 glyphs.

Name: Settler
Description: A survivor of the shattered world, ready to create new life on the World Shards.

Name: Redraw
Description: Drawing a new set of glyphs into your Hand, according to your Hand Size.

Name: Mitigate
Description: Mitigating a challenge, usually by filling its associated essence slots.

Name: Negative Glyph
Description: Glyphs with harmful Invocations, such as 涙 (Tears). Any such glyphs remaining in the hand at the end of a turn are cast automatically.

Name: Location
Description: A place on the World Shard waiting to be settled, chosen to begin a new Foray.

Name: Shortage
Description: A type of Yield that a Settlement is lacking. During Convergence, you can Fulfill these directly or by connecting the Settlement. Each unfulfilled shortage results in a loss of 5 inspiration.

Name: Insight
Description: Points earned by completing Stages. You can spend them in the Haven to permanently unlock new Skills.

Name: Shrink
Description: Reduce your hand size for the rest of the stage.

Name: Satisfy All
Description: Gain a number of yield points of each foray goal.

Name: Satisfy
Description: Gain a number of yield points of a random foray goal, prioritizing unsatisfied.

Name: Store
Description: Place this glyph on top of the draw stack.

Name: Recycle
Description: Draw random glyphs from the Discards, if available.

Name: Recall
Description: Choose one or more glyphs from the discards and draw them.

Name: Pick
Description: Choose one or more glyphs from the draw stack and draw them.

Name: Neglect
Description: Halve all gains of a given yield for the rest of the stage. Does not stack.

Name: Mirror
Description: Duplicate a random glyph in your hand.

Name: Lose
Description: Lose a number of yield points of a specific type.

Name: Lock
Description: Lock a site, preventing any more essence slots from being filled.

Name: Inspire
Description: Restore some amount of inspiration.

Name: Imitate
Description: Choose a glyph from the hand and one or more copies of it to your hand.

Name: Gain
Description: Lose a number of yield points of a specific type.

Name: Fill
Description: Fill a number of random unfilled essence slots in developments or tasks.

Name: Expand
Description: Increase your hand size for the rest of the stage.

Name: Fade Away
Description: Remove [b]all copies of[/b] the glyph for the rest of the stage.

Name: Echo
Description: Repeat the effects of the most recently cast glyph, as if cast by this glyph.

Name: Draw
Description: Draw one or more glyphs from the draw stack.

Name: Predict
Description: See the next glyphs you would draw from the draw stack, in order.

Name: Dissatisfy All
Description: Lose a number of yield points of each foray goal.

Name: Dissatisfy
Description: Lose a number of yield points of a random foray goal.

Name: Discard
Description: Randomly discard a number of glyphs.

Name: Despair
Description: Lose some amount of Inspiration.

Name: Conjure
Description: Add one or more copies of a glyph to your hand.

Name: Adapt
Description: Add one or more glyphs with a random essence you don't already have to your hand. The glyph being cast is considered to be in your hand.

Name: Connect
Description: Completing a Convergence Task during Convergence to connect a Settlement to the Shard Capital.

Name: Cast
Description: Using a glyph for its Invocations instead of slotting it into an Essence Slot. When a glyph is cast, all of its Invocations are cast.

Name: Rarity Tier
Description: The rarity tier of Glyphs determines their power. Higher tier Glyphs provide more Essences and stronger Invocations. Higher tier Glyphs are found later in an Expedition.

Name: Shard Capital
Description: A central hub that shares yields with connected settlements, growing stronger as more are linked. Its state carries over between phases.

Name: Basic Essence
Description: One of the three fundamental Essences of the world: Stability, Change, and Life. All Site require one basic essence for their initial Developments.

Name: Advanced Essence
Description: One of the four reflected Essences: Craft, Spirit, Radiance, and Connection. Advanced Site Developments require these.

Name: Add
Description: Adding a Glyph to your Glyph Deck for the rest of an Expedition, for example by choosing one at the end of a Foray.

Name: Split
Description: Add simple glyphs with each of this glyph's essences to your hand.

Name: Spread
Description: Duplicate a random glyph in your hand that has a certain essence type.

Name: Support
Description: Double all gains of a given yield for the rest of the stage. Does not stack.

Name: Top
Description: Add one or more copies of a specific glyph to the top of the draw stack.

Name: Mitigate
Description: Fill a number of random unfilled essence slots in a challenge. Benefits from bonuses to Fill.

Name: Continue
Description: Fill a number of random unfilled essence slots in developments or tasks with any essence slots already filled. Benefits from bonuses to Fill.

Name: Target
Description: Fill a number of random unfilled essence slots in developments that produce a specific yield. Benefits from bonuses to Fill.

Name: Preview Challenges
Description: Allows you to preview challenges before starting a foray.

Name: Challenges Skill Tree
Description: Skills that allow more control over Challenges.

Name: Restore Inspiration 一
Description: Restore [b]1[/b] point of Inspiration after each foray.

Name: Restore Inspiration 二
Description: Restore [b]2 more[/b] points of Inspiration after each foray.

Name: Max Inspiration 一
Description: Increases your maximum Inspiration by [b]5[/b] points.

Name: Max Inspiration 二
Description: Increases your maximum Inspiration by a [b]further 10[/b] points.

Name: Max Inspiration 三
Description: Increases your maximum Inspiration by a [b]further 10[/b] points.

Name: Max Inspiration 四
Description: Increases your maximum Inspiration by a [b]further 15[/b] points.

Name: Max Inspiration 五
Description: Increases your maximum Inspiration by a [b]further 15[/b] points.

Name: Max Inspiration 六
Description: Increases your maximum Inspiration by a [b]further 20[/b] points.

Name: Inspiration Skill Tree
Description: Skills that enhance Inspiration.

Name: Landmark: Verse Arena
Description: Unlocks the Verse Arena landmark, available in Town Squares, which allows you to restore Inspiration when global Beauty thresholds are met.

Name: Relic Reroll
Description: Allows you to reroll relic choices once per expedition.

Name: Relics Skill Tree
Description: Skills that provide more ways to access Relics.

Name: Landmark: Endless Ruin
Description: Unlocks the Endless Ruin landmark, available in the Wastelands, which allows you to acquire relics when global Safety thresholds are met.

Name: Mitigate Challenge 三
Description: Allows you to mitigate [b]1[/b] more challenge per expedition without using any glyphs.

Name: Salvaged Glyphs 一
Description: Allows you to salvage [b]1[/b] more glyph at the end of each Convergence.

Name: Salvaged Glyphs 二
Description: Allows you to salvage [b]1[/b] more glyph at the end of each Convergence.

Name: Mitigate Challenge 二
Description: Allows you to mitigate [b]1[/b] more challenge per expedition without using any glyphs.

Name: Mitigate Challenge 一
Description: Allows you to mitigate [b]1[/b] challenge per expedition without using any glyphs.

Name: Prevented Challenges 二
Description: Allows you to take precautions to prevent [b]1[/b] more challenge before starting an expedition.

Name: Prevented Challenges 一
Description: Allows you to take precautions to prevent a specific challenge before starting an expedition.

Name: Events Skill Tree
Description: Skills that allow more control over Events.

Name: Events Preview
Description: Allows you to preview events before starting a foray.

Name: Guaranteed Events 三
Description: Allows you to choose [b]1[/b] more guaranteed event.

Name: Guaranteed Events 二
Description: Allows you to choose [b]1[/b] more guaranteed event.

Name: Guaranteed Events 一
Description: Allows you to choose an event which will be guaranteed to happen, assuming its requirements are met.

Name: Events per Foray +1
Description: Allows 1 more event to appear during each foray.

Name: Extra Signature Glyph
Description: Allows you to select [b]1[/b] more signature glyph to include in your glyph deck when starting an expedition.

Name: Signature Glyph
Description: Allows you to select a signature glyph to include in your glyph deck when starting an expedition.

Name: Landmark: Woodblock Print Studio
Description: Unlocks the Woodblock Print Studio landmark, available in Large Buildings, which allows you to acquire previously inscribed glyphs when global Knowledge thresholds are met.

Name: Extra Settler Quests 二
Description: Allows you to take on [b]5[/b] more settler quests on the same expedition, if available.

Name: Goal Rerolls 一
Description: Allows you to reroll a foray goal [b]once[/b] per expedition.

Name: Goal Rerolls 二
Description: Allows you to reroll a foray goal [b]1[/b] more time per expedition.

Name: Goal Rerolls 三
Description: Allows you to reroll a foray goal [b]1[/b] more time per expedition.

Name: Settlement Skill Tree
Description: Skills that provide new ways to manage the Sites and Developments.

Name: Sites Per Phase +1
Description: Adds one extra site in each foray after every Convergence.

Name: Longer Surveys 一
Description: Increases the maximum number of encounters per survey by [b]2[/b].

Name: Longer Surveys 二
Description: Further increases the maximum number of encounters per survey by [b]2[/b].

Name: Shard Preview
Description: Allows you to preview the shard map before starting an expedition.

Name: Shard Choice
Description: Allows you to pick a different shard before starting an expedition any number of times.

Name: Survey Preparation 一
Description: Allows you to spend yields to gain bonuses for the duration of a survey.

Name: Survey Preparation 二
Description: Allows some survey preparations to be stacked twice.

Name: Scouting 一
Description: Increases the size of the area revealed by forays and surveys by [b]20%[/b].

Name: Scouting 二
Description: Increases the size of the area revealed by forays and surveys by a further [b]20%[/b].

Name: Exploration Skill Tree
Description: Skills that allow more control over Surveys and other shard exploration.

Name: Extra Settler Quests 一
Description: Allows you to take on [b]5[/b] more settler quests on the same expedition, if available.

Name: Preview Yields
Description: Allows you to preview all site yields before starting a foray, rather than just ones relevant to the foray goal.

Name: Packed In
Description: Allows settlements to overlap by up to 15% of their diameter.

Name: Development Freedom
Description: Allows you to reveal all possible developments of any site, even if they are irrelevant to the current foray goals.

Name: Insights from Excess
Description: Grants an Insight for every 10 yield points of any type that do not directly progress the foray goals during forays, up to 20.

Name: Insights from Discovery
Description: Grants an Insight for each discovery, such as new glyphs, new event choices, and so on.

Name: Everything is Unique
Description: Allows you to activate multiple unique developments within each expedition.

Name: Sites +1
Description: Adds one extra site in each foray.

Name: Create Site: Town Square
Description: Allows you to create a Town Square site once per expedition.

Name: Create Site: Small Building
Description: Allows you to create a Small Building site once per expedition.

Name: Create Site: Large Building
Description: Allows you to create a Large Building site once per expedition.

Name: Create Site: Lake
Description: Allows you to create a Lake site once per expedition.

Name: Uncommon Starting Relic
Description: Allows Uncommon relics to appear as random starting relics.

Name: Selected Starting Relic
Description: Allows you to select a specific relic to start with before each expedition, without being limited to specific choices.

Name: Random Starting Relic
Description: Grants you a choice of random relics at the start of each expedition.

Name: Relic Removal
Description: Allows you to remove relics at the Endless Ruin landmark.

Name: Landmark: Shard Council
Description: Unlocks the Shard Council landmark, always available in the shard capital, which allows you to exchange different yield types.

Name: Landmark: Post Road
Description: Unlocks the Post Road landmark, available in the Plains, which allows you to connect settlements before Convergence when global Harmony thresholds are met.

Name: Capital Skill Tree
Description: Skills that provide new ways to manage the shard capital.

Name: Capital Initial Provision
Description: Lets the capital provide one type of yield immediately when placed, depending on its biome.

Name: Craft Connection
Description: Allows you to create Connection glyphs by combining one of each basic essence during Convergence.

Name: Connect Settlements
Description: Allows you to connect a settlement to the shard capital. Settlements connected to the shard capital will share the yields they provide with all other connected settlements to fulfill their shortages.

Name: Capital Activated Provisions
Description: Allows you to use glyphs to make the capital provide any type of yield, assuming enough of that yield has been created on the shard.

Name: Shard Council
Description:
This hall in the Shard Capital manages shard-wide planning. Settlement representatives can coordinate here to direct their focus, even if it disrupts efficiency.

Here you can exchange any type of Yield for half as much of another Yield.

This landmark is always available in the Shard Capital.

[i]“Not all plans are efficient, but coordination has its own power. Even mismatched efforts can find purpose when aligned.”[/i]

Name: Communal Baths
Description:
Steam rises from the warm baths, its puffs carried away by the cool breeze. The stone walkways are worn smooth with use, and clean buckets are stacked neatly in a row.

Here you can purify your Glyph Deck and remove glyphs if a given amount of Productivity has been reached on the shard.

[i]“True work begins by letting go. In these waters, even stubborn thoughts dissolve, leaving only what matters.”[/i]

Name: Woodblock Print Studio
Description:
The masters of the studio are adept at reproducing scripture and paintings alike. By investing time and focus, scholars can find old teachings to print and spread among the populace.

Here you can print Inscribed Glyphs and add them to your Glyph Deck if a given amount of Knowledge has been reached on the shard.

[i]“What is written once may be forgotten; what is printed will travel.”[/i]

Name: Stone of Remembrance
Description:
The monument stands at the center of the square, marked with hundreds of inscriptions. Here, the settlers gather to honor their most important values.

Here you can make Glyphs Innate if a given amount of Food has been reached on the shard.

[i]“The people gather to remember what guided them through the hardships of days past.”[/i]

Name: Verse Arena
Description:
This arena is hosts regular contests of the lyrical variety. Poems recited here become a source of renewed inspiration for those who stop by.

Here you can restore some Inspiration if a given amount of Beauty has been reached on the shard.

[i]“In words, beauty endures. A single poem can carry hope farther than any road.”[/i]

Name: Endless Ruin
Description:
This unfathomably vast, ancient ruin stretches deep underground. Investigating it may put people at risk, but what they bring back could unlock new possibilities.

Here you can retrieve Relics from the ruins if a given amount of Safety has been reached on the shard.

[i]“Some truths are found only by those willing to reach into the dark.”[/i]

Name: Mirage Gate
Description:
This ancient gate is unlike the ones we are used to. It leads somewhere unknowable. Those who enter come back with insights unlike anything seen before, but after such an experience, they lose all interest in exploring mundane landscapes.

Here you can retrieve Glyphs of high Rarity Tier to add to your glyph deck once a given amount of Adventure has been reached on the shard.

[i]“What lies beyond is wondrous, but unsettling. Those who glimpse it rarely wish to linger in the familiar.”[/i]

Name: Post Road
Description:
A paved road stretches from the settlement and disappears into the horizon. Painted markers guide travelers between shaded milestones. Each new connection includes distant places into the communal network.

Here you can connect Settlements to the Shard Capital freely if a given amount of Harmony has been reached on the shard.

[i]“A road connects markets and spirits alike.”[/i]

Name: Accord Monument
Description: This town square is special. Within its temple and accompanying pagoda, the Great Accord is enshrined.

Name: Cat
Description: Luck will follow this cat anywhere.

Name: Crane
Description: A graceful companion, gathering strength through steadfast loyalty.

Name: Deer
Description: A harmonious spirit, connecting folks to their environment.

Name: Dog
Description: A steadfast guardian, sworn to protect the journey.

Name: Dragon
Description: A wise ally, reshaping all things with knowledge.

Name: Fox
Description: No one beats the fox when it comes to trickery.

Name: Frog
Description: This frog lets nothing go to waste.

Name: Carp
Description: A tiny dreamer, who believes even lost causes deserve one more try.

Name: Monkey
Description: An irreverent spirit, quick to mock hardship and quicker to outrun it.

Name: Snake
Description: A secretive friend, who keeps gifts hidden until the moment is right.

Name: Spider
Description: A dangerous ally, tempting the brave of heart but weak of will.

Name: Sea Bream
Description: A warm-hearted companion, happiest when others succeed.

Name: Tanuki
Description: This schemer is always rummaging around.

Name: Tiger
Description: A creature of pure power, taking on obstacles with brute force.

Name: Turtle
Description: A careful keeper, saving hope for the days when it is most needed.

Name: Inscription Skill Tree
Description: Skills that provide new ways to inscribe glyphs.

Name: Replace Starter Glyphs
Description: Allows you to replace starting glyphs with other Basic or Common glyphs.

Name: Kept Glyph
Description: Allows you to keep a glyph at the end of each expedition to take on your next expedition. Only glyphs added during the expedition are eligible.

Name: Double Salvaged Strokes
Description: Grants [b]double[/b] the strokes when salvaging glyphs at the end of each Convergence.

Name: Stroke Research
Description: Allows you to use insights to acquire strokes.

Name: Glyph Research
Description: Allows you to use insights to discover new glyphs. These would still need to be inscribed.

Name: Inscribe Glyph 四
Description: Allows you to inscribe glyphs of [b]Epic[/b] rarity tier for use as signature glyphs.

Name: Inscribe Glyph 三
Description: Allows you to inscribe glyphs of [b]Rare[/b] rarity tier for use as signature glyphs.

Name: Inscribe Glyph 二
Description: Allows you to inscribe glyphs of [b]Uncommon[/b] rarity tier for use as signature glyphs.

Name: Inscribe Glyph
Description: Allows you to salvage a glyph at the end of each phase, and inscribe glyphs of [b]Common[/b] rarity tier for use as signature glyphs.

Name: Landmark: Communal Baths
Description: Unlocks the Communal Baths landmark, available in Town Squares, which allows you to remove glyphs from your glyph deck when global Productivity thresholds are met.

Name: Landmark: Mirage Gate
Description: Unlocks the Mirage Gate landmark, available in the Deserts, which allows you to acquire high rarity glyphs when global Adventure thresholds are met.

Name: Landmark: Stone of Remembrance
Description: Unlocks the Stone of Remembrance landmark, available in Town Squares, which allows you to make glyphs innate when global Food thresholds are met.

Name: Glyph Skill Tree
Description: Skills that enhance the glyph deck.

Name: Reserve Glyph
Description: Allows you to reserve glyph reward choices.

Name: Quality Glyph Rerolls
Description: When glyph rewards are rerolled, their rarity tier is [b]10%[/b] higher. Does not stack.

Name: Glyph Reward Rerolls 四
Description: Allows you to reroll glyph reward choices [b]3 more[/b] times per expedition.

Name: Glyph Reward Rerolls 三
Description: Allows you to reroll glyph reward choices [b]2 more[/b] times per expedition.

Name: Glyph Reward Rerolls 二
Description: Allows you to reroll glyph reward choices [b]1 more[/b] time per expedition.

Name: Glyph Reward Rerolls 一
Description: Allows you to reroll glyph reward choices [b]1[/b] time per expedition.

Name: Glyph Mastery 三
Description: Increases the rarity tier of glyph rewards by a [b]further 15%[/b].

Name: Glyph Mastery 二
Description: Increases the rarity tier of glyph rewards by a [b]further 10%[/b].

Name: Glyph Mastery 一
Description: Increases the rarity tier of glyph rewards by [b]10%[/b].

Name: Replan 四
Description: Allows you to reshuffle your glyph deck and draw a new starting hand [b]1[/b] more time per expedition.

Name: Replan 三
